profile_text.body:
Greylock Partners describes itself as a leading venture capital firm based in Silicon Valley and an early partner of teams building companies that matter. According to its website, each Greylock partner makes only one or two new investments a year because the work demands depth, and the firm brings its full attention, network, and resources to every partnership. The site includes a quote stating that a Greylock partner should aspire to win the Oscar for the best supporting actor and that this reputation must be earned every day.

The firm was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, California, United States. It is a for-profit investor. No products or MCP servers are listed for Greylock Partners, and no litigation cases are recorded. The firm is associated with 281 law exposure entries in California.
